source.author: verg
source.text: Illam incendentem luctus Idaeus et Actor Illionei monitu et multum lacrimantis Iuli corripiunt interque manus sub tecta reponunt.
source.text_original: Illam incendentem luctus Idaeus et Actor / Illionei monitu et multum lacrimantis Iuli / corripiunt interque manus sub tecta reponunt.
source.text_english: Idaeus and Actor seize her as she was kindling grief, at the urging of Ilioneus and at the many tears of Iulus, and carry her off between them and place her under cover.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: At ducis imperiis Minyae monituque frequentes puppem umeris subeunt et tento poplite proni decurrunt intrantque fretum.
reuse.text_original: At ducis imperiis Minyae monituque frequentes / puppem umeris subeunt et tento poplite proni / decurrunt intrantque fretum.
reuse.text_english: But at the commander’s orders and under his urging, the many Minyae take up the ship on their shoulders and, with bent knees, run downhill and enter the strait.
